componentPlan.focusQuote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Checks recall of concrete uses and facts before studying the ordered process

componentPlan.focusQuote: To amplify a segment of DNA using PCR, the sample is first heated so the DNA denatures, or separates into two pieces of single-stranded DNA.
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Models the ordered denature and synthesis cycle in the order taught on the page

overview.headline: PCR copies small DNA segments for lab study through repeated heating and building

keyPoints.point: PCR amplifies small segments of DNA to provide material for molecular and genetic analyses
keyPoints.quote: Because significant amounts of a sample of DNA are necessary for molecular and genetic analyses

keyPoints.point: Amplified DNA supports mapping techniques in laboratory work and genome projects
keyPoints.quote: For example, most mapping techniques in the Human Genome Project (HGP) relied on PCR.

keyPoints.point: A sample is heated so DNA denatures and separates into pieces for copying
keyPoints.quote: To amplify a segment of DNA using PCR, the sample is first heated so the DNA denatures, or separates into two pieces of single-stranded DNA.

keyPoints.point: The cycling process is automated and completes synthesis work in a few hours
keyPoints.quote: The entire cycling process of PCR is automated and can be completed in just a few hours.

keyTerms.gloss: Small segments of genetic material copied by the technique
keyTerms.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.

keyTerms.gloss: Method that produces amplified DNA for laboratory procedures
keyTerms.quote: Once amplified, the DNA produced by PCR can be used in many different laboratory procedures.

keyTerms.gloss: Enzyme that builds new strands using original strands as templates
keyTerms.quote: Next, an enzyme called "Taq polymerase" synthesizes - builds - two new strands of DNA, using the original strands as templates.

keyTerms.gloss: Machine programmed to alter temperature to direct reaction steps
keyTerms.quote: It is directed by a machine called a thermocycler, which is programmed to alter the temperature of the reaction

analysis.pageCoverage: Explains what PCR is, what amplified DNA is used for, and how repeated heating and synthesis makes copies
analysis.subject: biology
